tldr: 台股上週五重挫2.49%收45,211.83點（台積電跌至2,370元），兩日累挫逾1,800點、外資賣超逾1,800億元。
AI伺服器需求續撐成長主軸，鴻海前三季AI伺服器營收破兆、全年營收挑戰8.1兆元新高。
金管會2026金檢聚焦防詐、防洗錢與資安韌性，保險業導入IFRS與ICS新制，高資產信託規模達9.83兆元。
央行利率連10凍、上修2026 GDP至11.48%，通膨略超2%警戒、維持偏緊操作。
美股上週五科技股領跌，標普500跌1.82%創6月來最大跌幅，英特爾暴跌近29%，蘋果市值超車輝達。

items.title_zh: 台股上週五重挫2.49% 外資撤離殺低盤面
items.title_en: TAIEX tumbles 2.5% Friday as foreign funds flee
items.summary_zh: 加權指數上週五(10/30)收45,211.83點，大跌1,156.5點、跌幅2.49%，權值王台積電收2,370元、跌45元。受美國科技巨頭財報不如預期與AI評價偏高拖累，市場風險趨避情緒升溫，資金全面撤出，終場指數勉強守住45,000點整數關卡，成交量維持高檔。
items.summary_en: The benchmark TAIEX closed Friday at 45,211.83, down 1,156.5 points (-2.49%), its sharpest fall in weeks. Market heavyweight TSMC dropped NT$45 to NT$2,370 as disappointing US big-tech earnings and stretched AI valuations triggered broad risk-off selling. Turnover stayed heavy while the index clung just above the key 45,000 level into the weekend.

items.title_zh: 兩日累挫逾1,800點 45,000點保衛戰登場
items.title_en: Two-day rout tops 1,800 points as 45,000 defense looms
items.summary_zh: 台股上週四、五兩個交易日合計重挫約1,824點，外資同期賣超逾1,800億元，資金自高評價的AI與半導體族群撤出。法人示警45,000點為後市關鍵支撐，若失守恐下探44,000甚至42,000點區間，提醒投資人密切留意量能與外資買賣超動向變化。
items.summary_en: Across Thursday and Friday the TAIEX shed roughly 1,824 points combined, with foreign investors net-selling more than NT$180 billion as they rotated out of richly valued AI and semiconductor names. Analysts flagged 45,000 as the critical support to watch, warning that a decisive break could open the door toward the 44,000–42,000 zone.

items.title_zh: 鴻海前三季AI伺服器營收破兆 Q4機櫃拚高雙位數成長
items.title_en: Foxconn's AI server revenue tops NT$1 trillion in first nine months
items.summary_zh: 鴻海法說會表示，前三季AI伺服器營收已突破新台幣兆元，第四季機櫃出貨看高雙位數季增，全年營運動能維持強勁。顯示AI基礎建設需求仍是台灣電子供應鏈最重要的成長引擎，相關機櫃、散熱與電源供應鏈後市續受市場高度關注。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai (Foxconn) told investors its AI server revenue has already exceeded NT$1 trillion through the first three quarters, with Q4 rack shipments guided to grow at a high double-digit sequential pace. The contract-manufacturing giant reaffirmed strong full-year momentum, underscoring that AI infrastructure demand remains the dominant growth engine for Taiwan's electronics supply chain.

items.title_zh: 鴻海拚全年營收8.1兆創新高 AI機櫃挑大樑
items.title_en: Foxconn on track for record NT$8.1 trillion revenue, led by AI racks
items.summary_zh: 受惠AI伺服器需求強勁，鴻海全年營收挑戰約8.1兆元、改寫歷史新高，雲端網路產品首度超車手機成為最大營收來源。公司由iPhone代工龍頭蛻變為AI機櫃要角，凸顯台灣AI硬體供應鏈結構性成長循環延續，帶動相關零組件廠商營運同步升溫。
items.summary_en: Riding surging AI server demand, Hon Hai is heading for record annual revenue of around NT$8.1 trillion, with its cloud and networking segment overtaking smartphones as the top sales driver. The shift cements Foxconn's transformation from an iPhone assembler into a leading AI rack maker and reinforces the structural upcycle across Taiwan's AI hardware names.

items.title_zh: 金管會2026金檢聚焦防詐、防洗錢與資安韌性
items.title_en: FSC sets 2026 exam focus on fraud, AML and cyber-resilience
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布2026年金檢重點，將防制詐騙、防制洗錢、金融消費者權益保護及資通安全韌性列為四大特別關注領域，合計113項重點。國銀與外銀在台分行另須強化客戶開戶的地緣性與目的合理性審查，顯示主管機關對明年金融監理要求更趨嚴格，業者須提早布局因應。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission flagged four priority areas for its 2026 financial examinations—anti-fraud, anti-money-laundering, financial consumer protection and cyber-security resilience—spanning a combined 113 inspection points. Domestic banks and foreign branches will also face tighter account-opening scrutiny on customer location and purpose, signalling heightened supervisory expectations for the year ahead.

items.title_zh: 保險業2026導入IFRS與ICS新制 營收申報放寬至15日
items.title_en: New insurance accounting regime and reporting relief take effect in 2026
items.summary_zh: 2026年起保險業正式適用IFRS與ICS清償能力新制，金管會預期長期保證型保單將逐步退場。考量新制使保險收入計算更繁瑣，多數金控月營收申報期限自每月10日放寬至15日，惟國票金、玉山金、永豐金等仍須於10日前公告，牽動壽險業商品策略與財報揭露節奏。
items.summary_en: From 2026 Taiwan's insurers adopt the IFRS 17 and ICS solvency frameworks, which the FSC expects will gradually phase out long-term guaranteed policies. To ease the heavier revenue-calculation workload, most financial holding companies may delay monthly revenue disclosure from the 10th to the 15th, though groups such as Waterland, E.Sun and SinoPac must still report by the 10th.

items.title_zh: KPMG：台灣高資產族群2026持續擴張 信託規模達9.83兆
items.title_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth pool keeps expanding into 2026, KPMG says
items.summary_zh: KPMG引用信託公會統計指出，截至2025年第4季國內銀行信託業務規模達9.83兆元、年增7%。資產逾1億元的高資產人口估由2023年約9.3萬人增至2025年11.8萬人，2026年上看12.4萬人，其中約74%已持有境外資產，顯示跨境資產配置與世代傳承需求帶動財管業務成長。
items.summary_en: A KPMG report citing trust-association data put domestic bank trust assets at NT$9.83 trillion as of Q4 2025, up 7% year-on-year. Residents with over NT$100 million in assets are estimated to have risen from about 93,000 in 2023 to 118,000 in 2025 and may reach 124,000 in 2026, with roughly 74% already holding offshore assets—underscoring demand for cross-border allocation and succession planning.

items.title_zh: 台新銀行深化高資產服務 奪PBI全球財富管理雙獎
items.title_en: Taishin Bank wins double PBI global wealth-management awards
items.summary_zh: 台新銀行以深化高資產客戶服務及AI創新，一舉拿下PBI（Private Banker International）全球財富管理大獎雙獎。該行指出，高資產客戶需求已從傳統投資商品配置，轉向資產負債整合管理，並更重視資產保全、跨境配置與世代傳承，反映國內私人銀行競爭主軸正加速轉變。
items.summary_en: Taishin Bank secured two honours at the Private Banker International (PBI) global wealth-management awards, recognising its deepened high-net-worth services and AI-driven innovation. The bank noted affluent clients' needs have shifted from traditional product allocation toward integrated asset-and-liability management, asset preservation, cross-border allocation and generational transfer—trends reshaping Taiwan's private-banking competition.

items.title_zh: 擬制遺產修法三讀 死亡前2年贈與併入遺產課稅
items.title_en: Taiwan tightens estate-tax rules on gifts made before death
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過《遺產及贈與稅法》修正，被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與配偶、各順序繼承人及其配偶的財產須併入遺產總額課稅，並改以受贈人為納稅義務人。此修正回應憲法法庭憲判字第11號判決，財政部正研擬施行細則與申辦系統，條文公布後將牽動高資產族群的傳承與贈與規劃布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's legislature passed amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act requiring assets gifted to a spouse, heirs or their spouses within two years before death to be folded back into the taxable estate, with the recipient now liable for the related estate tax. Responding to a Constitutional Court ruling, the change will reshape succession planning once promulgated; the Finance Ministry is revising sub-regulations and filing systems.

items.title_zh: 2026遺贈稅免稅額維持不變 遺產稅收創新高
items.title_en: 2026 estate-tax thresholds unchanged as estate-tax revenue hits record
items.summary_zh: 財政部公告，2026年發生繼承或贈與案件適用的免稅額、各項扣除額及課稅級距均維持不變，因適用消費者物價指數漲幅未達調整門檻。遺產稅收續創高峰，2025年全年達443.3億元創史上新高，2026年前4月已達174.2億元，顯示高資產傳承與稅務規劃需求持續升溫。
items.summary_en: The Finance Ministry confirmed 2026 exemption amounts, deductions and tax brackets for inheritance and gift tax stay unchanged because the relevant CPI move did not reach the adjustment threshold. Estate-tax revenue hit a record NT$44.33 billion in 2025 and stayed elevated, reaching NT$17.42 billion in the first four months of 2026, keeping wealth-transfer planning firmly in focus.

items.title_zh: 央行利率連10凍 上修2026成長率至11.48%
items.title_en: Central bank holds rates again, lifts 2026 growth forecast
items.summary_zh: 中央銀行9月理監事會維持政策利率不變，已連續10個季度按兵不動，並未跟進聯準會降息，強調兼顧經濟成長與通膨。受惠AI相關出口與民間投資強勁，央行將2026年全年GDP成長率預估大幅上修至11.48%，上半年經濟成長約14.15%，顯示對AI帶動的擴張深具信心。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank left policy rates unchanged at its September board meeting—extending the hold to ten straight quarters—and declined to follow the Fed, citing both growth and inflation. Buoyed by AI-driven exports and private investment, it sharply raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 11.48% after first-half growth of about 14.15%, signalling confidence in the AI-led expansion.

items.title_zh: 通膨略超警戒區 央行維持偏緊操作
items.title_en: Inflation edges above alert line, keeping policy on the tight side
items.summary_zh: 央行將2026年CPI預估上修至2.03%、核心CPI上修至2.16%，指出通膨壓力仍略高於2%警戒區。總裁楊金龍表示還有時間觀察，貨幣政策操作維持偏緊以錨定通膨預期。顯示即便全球進入降息循環，台灣短期內寬鬆空間仍相對有限，市場須關注後續物價與匯率走勢。
items.summary_en: The central bank nudged its 2026 CPI forecast up to 2.03% and core CPI to 2.16%, noting inflation remains above the 2% alert zone. Governor Yang Chin-long said there is still time to observe and that monetary operations stay on the tighter side to anchor inflation expectations, suggesting limited room for near-term easing even as global peers cut rates.

items.title_zh: 美科技股賣壓再起 英特爾、亞馬遜展望疲弱
items.title_en: US tech selloff deepens on weak Intel and Amazon outlooks
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體報導，英特爾與亞馬遜財報後釋出的展望低於市場預期，引發美國科技股新一波賣壓。英特爾盤後股價重挫逾20%，第4季營收預估低於共識、毛利率估降至38%；亞馬遜則因核心網路零售成長疲弱，拖累那斯達克100期貨一度下跌1.7%，連動牽引台股電子權值股的情緒。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese market coverage highlighted a second wave of selling in US tech after Intel and Amazon issued post-earnings guidance below expectations. Intel's shares slumped more than 20% after hours on a weaker Q4 revenue outlook and margins seen falling to 38%, while Amazon flagged soft core online-retail growth, dragging Nasdaq-100 futures down as much as 1.7%.

items.title_zh: 道瓊挫至51,770點 科技股領跌衝擊華爾街
items.title_en: Dow slides to 51,770 as tech-led rout hits Wall Street
items.summary_zh: 國際股市受科技股領跌拖累，道瓊工業指數下滑至51,770.31點，企業財報表現不如預期。大型科技與AI相關類股普遍走弱，風險趨避情緒蔓延全球，投資人重新評估偏高的評價與AI資本支出步調，並為接下來數據密集的一週預作準備，台股開盤料同步承壓。
items.summary_en: Global equities were rattled as the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell to 51,770.31 amid a tech-led selloff and disappointing corporate earnings. Weakness across megacap technology and AI-linked names spread risk-off sentiment worldwide, with investors reassessing stretched valuations and the pace of AI capital spending heading into a data-heavy week.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤回顧：10月以科技股重挫作收（2026-10-30，最近交易日）
items.title_en: Wall Street closes a brutal week as October ends in a tech-led rout (2026-10-30)
items.summary_zh: 美股上週五收黑，為10月畫下沉重句點。標普500指數跌1.82%至7,580.07點，創6月以來最大單日跌幅；那斯達克綜合指數跌2.86%至25,437.00點，道瓊跌1.09%（約572點）至51,770.31點。這是連續第二個交易日下跌，導火線為科技巨頭財報不佳，市場重燃對AI支出可持續性的疑慮。
items.summary_en: US stocks tumbled Friday to cap a brutal end to October. The S&P 500 fell 1.82% to 7,580.07—its worst day since June—while the Nasdaq Composite dropped 2.86% to 25,437.00 and the Dow slid 1.09% (about 572 points) to 51,770.31. A second straight day of selling followed disappointing big-tech earnings and renewed doubts about the sustainability of AI spending.

items.title_zh: 英特爾重挫近29% 創1974年來最慘單日（2026-10-30）
items.title_en: Intel suffers worst day since 1974 on grim guidance (2026-10-30)
items.summary_zh: 英特爾股價上週五暴跌約28.6%，寫下1974年以來最大單日跌幅，起因為財報不佳與財測疲弱。英特爾的崩跌成為當日科技股災焦點，並拖累輝達(Nvidia)與超微(AMD)同步走低，凸顯投資人對半導體產業獲利能力與競爭態勢的憂慮，進一步打擊市場信心。
items.summary_en: Intel shares cratered about 28.6% on Friday—its worst single-day drop since 1974—after disappointing results and weak forward guidance. The chipmaker's slump was a focal point of the session's tech wreckage, which also dragged down Nvidia and AMD, underscoring investor anxiety over profitability and competitive positioning across the semiconductor sector.

items.title_zh: 亞馬遜、Alphabet財報不如預期 再掀AI支出疑慮（2026-10-30）
items.title_en: Amazon and Alphabet earnings misses revive AI-spending doubts (2026-10-30)
items.summary_zh: 美股連續第二日下跌，導火線為亞馬遜與Alphabet罕見財報不如預期，再度引發市場對AI榮景可持續性的擔憂。亞馬遜每股盈餘1.89美元低於1.96美元的市場共識，惟AWS雲端業務營收年增39%；Alphabet搜尋營收則不及約649億美元的預期，衝擊大型科技股投資情緒與後市評價。
items.summary_en: Stocks fell for a second day after Amazon and Alphabet posted rare earnings misses, reigniting worries over whether the AI boom is sustainable. Amazon's EPS of $1.89 came in below the $1.96 consensus, though AWS cloud sales grew 39% year-on-year, while Alphabet's search revenue fell short of the roughly $64.9 billion expected, pressuring megacap tech sentiment.

items.title_zh: 蘋果超車輝達 重返全球市值王（2026-10-30）
items.title_en: Apple overtakes Nvidia as world's most valuable company (2026-10-30)
items.summary_zh: 蘋果上週五重返全球市值最高企業寶座，以約5.03兆美元市值超越輝達(Nvidia)。此里程碑出現在蘋果將於隔週一公布財報之前，為市場帶來少見亮點。在AI驅動的評價重估席捲全球之際，投資人於大型科技股間重新輪動，蘋果相對抗跌凸顯資金尋求避風港的態勢。
items.summary_en: Apple reclaimed the title of world's most valuable company on Friday, overtaking Nvidia with a market capitalisation of about $5.03 trillion. The milestone came ahead of Apple's own earnings report due the following Monday, offering a rare bright spot as investors rotated within megacap tech amid the broader AI-driven valuation reset sweeping the market.
